_comment: The bus event contract (embodiment/bus.py, plan task t13, spec target h16). This is a CONTRACT between embodiment/bus.py and the dashboard web app's own tests (plan task t17): both sides validate against these files, so the two cannot drift apart silently. This is a hand-rolled, minimal schema representation (not full JSON-Schema draft syntax) -- 'required' lists field names that MUST be present in an event's 'data' object; a JSON value of null still counts as present. Fields not listed under 'required' MAY be present -- extra fields are always allowed. See the per-kind *.json files in this directory for one full, valid example envelope per kind.

types.gap: integer (present only when > 0; count of events this subscriber dropped since its last delivery)

state.note: daemon up/down/voice-on. status is a short token, never free text.

mic.note: hot: boolean. ear: which input ('local'/'remote'/etc, host-defined token).

turn.note: phase: 'started'/'finished'. step_count: integer. degradation CODES only -- never text.

transcript.note: SPEECH-CARRYING. role: 'user' or 'assistant'. text: the actual words. Only delivered to a Subscription that asked for this kind.

degradation.note: the ONE folded shape (see embodiment.bus.fold_degradation). code and reason never carry speech, secrets, or raw attacker-controlled ids.

features.note: the t8 audio feature frame, per direction. direction: 'in' or 'out'. env: base64 min/max envelope. zero_crossing_hz may be null. HIGH RATE (~30/s per direction) -- first kind dropped under subscriber back-pressure.

clients.note: how many dashboards are attached. count: integer. remote: integer (subset of count that are non-local).

heartbeat.note: emitted at a fixed interval (embodiment.bus.HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_S). data is typically empty.

conversation.note: id: a session-log id (safe charset). status: 'settled' -- no message for the quiet period (d7). last: epoch seconds of the last turn. turns: the operator's turns. Never text: 'embodiment history export --id' carries the words.

todo.note: A to-do was marked (d16); the library is its source (embodiment#105). id: the checklist id (pocket.<uuid>.<n>) of a library to-do line; recording_id: the recording it came from. done: true or false. at: epoch seconds. by: 'operator' (the page) or 'gwen' (on the operator's words). Also carries the whole to-do (text, recording_id, title, date) and timestamps, so culture-rules can file the list in the library.

mesh.note: SPEECH-CARRYING (t15): Gwen on the Culture mesh. event: one of 'ask_posted' (ask_id, channel, thread, text = the question, expires_at), 'answer_arrived' (ask_id, nick, channel, thread, text = the agent's words, UNTRUSTED, late, after_expiry, ambiguous, rule), 'ask_expired' (ask_id, channel, thread), 'agent_contacted' (nick, channel or null for a DM, thread, direct, text = the agent's words, UNTRUSTED), 'gwen_replied' (nick, channel, thread, direct, text = Gwen's reply, sent: whether the mesh client accepted it). conversation_id: the session-log id the event belongs to (the ask's conversation, or the agent's own). at: epoch seconds.
